confidence_notes: Recent aggregated Copenhagen prices support the meal, coffee and beer estimates. Cocktail and wine prices are less standardized and use local drink-menu prices and their relationship to beer. July accommodation estimates are holistic high-season estimates; I did not inspect booking pages or current listings.
comparable_city_reasoning: No comparable city was used. Food and drink anchors use Copenhagen price data; accommodation reflects its high-cost Nordic capital profile and July tourism demand.
